name: Turboism with fx
description: ACP v1 Agent and Settings windows that connect Turboism's verified managed fx runtime to the authenticated MCP server.

dependencies.reason: Requires the authenticated Turboism MCP endpoint before creating an fx ACP session.

permissions.reason: Registers the action that opens the fx Agent window.
Adds the fx Agent button immediately beside the Turboism Home toolbar entry.
Restores the advanced custom executable override, active durable session identifier, compatibility acknowledgement, and user-authored initial instructions.
Persists the optional custom executable override and user-authored launch state; provider/model catalogs, credentials, transcript data, and MCP authorization are never stored.
Starts and supervises the verified managed fx v0.0.5 ACP subprocess or an explicitly selected advanced custom override.

On explicit user request, downloads one exact reviewed fx v0.0.5 release asset for the current supported platform, verifies its pinned size and SHA-256, and atomically installs or repairs the managed runtime.
Reads the current authenticated loopback MCP endpoint through the runtime's non-persistent connection boundary.
